titleEn: Sum of Root To Leaf Binary Numbers
title: 从根到叶的二进制数之和
summary: 二叉树节点值为零或一，每条根到叶路径组成一个二进制数，求所有路径数值之和。
insight: DFS 过程中把前缀左移一位并加入当前比特；到叶节点时该前缀就是完整数值，非叶返回左右子树和。
pitfalls: 叶节点定义为左右孩子都为空
题目保证结果在整数范围内

solutions.title: DFS 二进制前缀
solutions.idea: 沿路径滚动构造数值并在叶端累加。
steps: 若叶节点返回 current，否则返回 dfs(left,current)+dfs(right,current)

code.java: class Solution { public int sumRootToLeaf(TreeNode root){return dfs(root,0);}private int dfs(TreeNode node,int prefix){if(node==null)return 0;int current=(prefix<<1)|node.val;if(node.left==null&&node.right==null)return current;return dfs(node.left,current)+dfs(node.right,current);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun sumRootToLeaf(root:TreeNode?):Int=dfs(root,0);private fun dfs(node:TreeNode?,prefix:Int):Int{node?:return 0;val current=(prefix shl 1) or node.`val`;if(node.left==null&&node.right==null)return current;return dfs(node.left,current)+dfs(node.right,current)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int dfs(TreeNode* node,int prefix){if(!node)return 0;int current=prefix<<1|node->val;if(!node->left&&!node->right)return current;return dfs(node->left,current)+dfs(node->right,current);}public:int sumRootToLeaf(TreeNode* root){return dfs(root,0);} };
